title: Refractive index value
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be n = √6/2.

title: Total time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be t = (√3 + 1)R / c.

title: Apply Snell's Law at D
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies Snell's law (n = sin i / sin r) using the 60° incidence and 45° refraction angles at point D.

title: Geometry for angles at D
description: Important Criteria: Correctly deduces the angle of incidence (i = 60°) and angle of refraction (r = 45°) at point D from the given distance √3 R/2 and DE = √2 R.

title: Path segmentation and speeds
description: Important Criteria: Correctly segments the total time as t = (DE / v) + (EF / c), where v = c/n is the speed in the medium.

title: Geometry for segment EF
description: Important Criteria: Correctly deduces that EF = R, likely from analyzing triangle EFO and the refraction at point E.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent units (R for distance, c for speed) leading to a final time with correct units of time.

title: Sign or angle error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize misidentifying the incident or refracted angle at point D (e.g., using sine of 30° instead of 60°).

title: Incorrect speed in medium
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize using the wrong speed for segment DE (e.g., using c instead of v = c/n).
